# 7-Zip 26.05

Unmodified `7z.exe` and `7z.dll` are distributed with AuraZip as an external compression engine. Copyright Igor Pavlov and the contributors named in License.txt. AuraZip does not implement RAR compression.

Official release: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/tag/26.05

The exact corresponding upstream source is included as `7z2605-src.7z`. See `License.txt` and `LGPL-2.1.txt` for the distribution terms, including BSD notices and the unRAR restriction.
